Motorists and pedestrians pass by a mural depicting workers’ struggles, calling for a wage increase and lower prices of basic goods, in Quezon City on Friday, May 1. Labor groups and rights advocates mark Labor Day with a protest calling for a ₱1,200 living wage, an end to contractualization, and the abolition of the regional wage rate system. 

📸: Santi San Juan/MB

Thousands of members from various groups march along España Boulevard in Manila on Friday, May 1, during the Labor Day protest, as workers and activists call for higher wages, lower prices of goods, and stronger labor protections. Organized by major labor coalitions, the mobilization forms part of a nationwide action led by groups such as Kilusang Mayo Uno and allied organizations, with demonstrators proceeding toward Mendiola.

Participants from different sectors carry placards and chant demands addressing economic hardships, including inflation and stagnant wages affecting Filipino workers. 

📸: Mark Balmores/MB
